values.note: Carroll County posts one rate for everyone (no resident/non-resident split): water-and-electric sites $40 a night, full-hookup sites $50; senior (62+) rates on request. The county also lists a $5 daily park pass per vehicle ($50 annual, all county parks); the page does not say whether campers pay it. $10 cancellation fee, no refund within 14 days of arrival.

fees.source: https://www.carrollcountyga.gov/290/John-Tanner-Park (Camping Fees: 'Full Hookup RV Sites $50', 'Water and Electric Only Sites $40', '*Senior Rates available upon request'; Facility Rates: 'Daily Park Pass $5 per vehicle'; Cancellation Policy), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: https://www.carrollcountyga.gov/290/John-Tanner-Park ('Full Hookup RV Sites', 'Water and Electric Only Sites'; no amperage given), read 2026-10-29

sites.source: https://www.carrollcountyga.gov/290/John-Tanner-Park says nothing about pull-throughs or pad sizes; the derived value came from note prose with no operator source. Cleared, read 2026-10-29.

booking.source: https://www.carrollcountyga.gov/290/John-Tanner-Park ('For reservations, call 770-830-2222 or e-mail for more information'), read 2026-10-29

note: Carroll County park (former John Tanner State Park, county-run since 2010; 354 Tanner Beach Rd, Carrollton). 31-32 gravel RV sites in the woods east of the beach. Two lakes (12 & 16 acre) with large sand beach. --Claude
summary: County page: $40 water/electric, $50 full hookup (one rate, no non-resident split; stored 40-50 confirmed), seniors on request, $5 daily vehicle pass listed (not said to apply to campers); reservations by phone 770-830-2222 (confirmed, stored phone matches county and Google). Sewer added (full-hookup sites). The county gives no site count, amperage, pad sizes, season or pull-throughs: derived pull_through cleared, electric left unknown. Waterfront: pads sit in woods ~130 m east of the beach lake's shore and ~250 m from the lower lake - stored 'not waterfront' stands, no lead. Pin ~200 m west of the campers seen on imagery (~33.6015,-85.1657), under the threshold. Note trimmed of hookups/pads/booking.
